Module org.microbean.bean
Package org.microbean.bean

Record Class BeanSelection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.microbean.bean.BeanSelection
Record Components:
beanSelectionCriteria - a non-null BeanSelectionCriteria
beans - a non-null List of Beans selected by the BeanSelectionCriteria
public record BeanSelection(BeanSelectionCriteria beanSelectionCriteria, List<Bean<?>> beans) extends Record
A pairing of a BeanSelectionCriteria used to select a List of Beans from somewhere, and the immutable List of Beans so selected.
Author:
Laird Nelson

  • Constructor Details

    • BeanSelection

      public BeanSelection(BeanSelectionCriteria beanSelectionCriteria, List<Bean<?>> beans)
      Creates a new BeanSelection.
      Parameters:
      beanSelectionCriteria - a non-null BeanSelectionCriteria
      beans - a non-null List of Beans selected by the BeanSelectionCriteria
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either beanSelectionCriteria or beans is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied BeanSelectionCriteria does not select all of the Beans in the supplied List of Beans
      See Also:
      • BeanSelectionCriteria.selects(Bean)
